name: ai-control-center
description: Local-first supervised multi-agent control center for CLI coding and design agents

scripts.check: python -m py_compile app/server.py app/real_agents.py app/workspace.py app/local_tools.py app/execution_support.py && node --check app/server/server.mjs && node --check app/server/owner-policy.mjs
scripts.test: python -m unittest discover -s test -p "test_*.py" && node --test test/*.test.mjs
